messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

item: "tell your doctor if you have ever had liver or kidney disease"
set: ["tell your doctor if you have ever had liver or kidney disease", "tell doctor if ever had kidney disease", "tell doctor if ever had liver disease or liver impairment", "tell doctor if have or have ever had kidney or pancreas disease", "tell your doctor if you have ever had diabetes", "tell your doctor if you have ever had anemia", "tell your doctor if you have ever had thyroiditis", "tell your doctor if you have ever had heart problems", "tell your doctor if you have ever had thyroid nodule", "tell your doctor if you have ever had weak bones", "tell doctor if have or had liver problems", "tell doctor if have or had kidney problems", "tell your doctor if you have ever had problems with your pituitary or adrenal gland", "tell your doctor if you have ever had blood clot or blood clotting disorder", "tell your doctor if you have ever had allergy to any food or drugs", "kidney or liver disease"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
